Program Description

For students who've finished high school but don’t meet the entry requirements for university, a Foundation Certificate can help them gain entry to an undergraduate degree. After completing this pathway option students qualify for progression to the 1st year of an undergraduate degree at City, University of London.

A student’s course length is determined mainly by their English language level (UKVI IELTS score). Students on all course lengths take a set of common or similar modules to gain a solid base of skills for university. Students taking a course longer than 2 terms, will take additional modules designed to improve one or more of their English language level, academic skills, and basic knowledge of particular subjects.

Bachelor of Law (Honours) - Law

This LLB Law degree gives students a foundation in the essential skills and knowledge needed to be successful in law and related fields.

It gives students a range of transferable skills which will help if they want to pursue a career path both within and outside law. Students will leave confident in their abilities and equipped with the skills demanded by employers. Students will be trained to deal with challenging situations in the law or law related workplace and demonstrate a high degree of professionalism in their work environment.

The knowledge and intellectual competencies students gain will enable them to develop as a mature, professional individual. This degree is also highly internationalised in its content, delivery and assessment strategies. City aims to produce highly qualified individuals with a global perspective on the law.

Bachelor of Science (Honours) - Accounting and Finance

Ranked 2nd best in London*, this BSc equips students with the knowledge and skills they need to excel in their accountancy or finance career.

Students will become proficient in all areas of accounting and finance, from financial accounting and corporate finance to financial management, taxation and economics.

Students also have the highly valuable option of a study abroad sandwich year at one of City's highly-respected partner institutions across the world. In an increasingly globalised business environment, this is excellent preparation.

The Accounting and Finance degree is both highly selective and highly demanding. Students will be working hard for the rewards it delivers. The degree is delivered in strategic partnership with the Institute of Chartered Accountants in England and Wales (ICAEW). By meeting the relevant criteria, BSc Accounting and Finance students can achieve up to eight exemptions from the ICAEW's Chartered Accountant qualification (ACA) and receive similar exemptions from other professional accountancy bodies.

City offers a wide variety of specialisations: central banking, managerial finance, commercial and retail banking, financial analysis, operations, or strategy.

Bachelor of Science (Honours) - Business Management with Social Purpose

Ranked 2nd in London for Business, Management, and Marketing*, students will gain the knowledge and skills to lead on change and address the fundamental issues in society.

Students will learn about strategy, human resources, operational management, finance and accounting, marketing, corporate reputation management, social entrepreneurship and enterprise, corporate social responsibility and investment, non-profit management and the management of culture, values and business ethics.

Students will also apply the principles they learn to real-world scenarios. In their third year, for example, the final project involves working with major firms and enterprises to assess their engagement with social enterprise and corporate social responsibility. If the course is longer than 2 terms, students will take additional modules designed to improve one or more of their English language level, academic skills, and basic knowledge of particular subjects.

Master of Arts - International Journalism

The course is suitable for students with a good first degree, and a strong interest in international news and the way it is reported. The course combines a strong emphasis on practice with rigorous academic discussion of current trends in global journalism.

The MA in International Journalism is a keystone course at City and has built up a worldwide reputation. This course has been running since 1982 and has more than 1,000 alumni working in journalism around the world.

On this course students will gain from using both traditional and contemporary journalism tools, and acquire comprehensive skills, which they can take back to their own country or move on with to anywhere in the world.

In order to prepare students for the publishing world visiting lecturers from the industry contribute to the programme throughout the teaching year.

Master of Science - Health Management

Students will develop a comprehensive portfolio of business skills that will enhance their organisational leadership capacity to build processes, systems and structures, plan ahead and deliver change. Working in groups and the real-life activities will develop their personal leadership abilities to influence, coach, present, work in and lead teams, develop themselves and others.

The course is applied and industry relevant. The curriculum is international and cross-sector. There are many expert guest speakers.
